# Secrets and API-Key Exposure Patterns
# Regular expressions (ERE/PCRE) and search commands. Patterns only: do not add real or realistic-looking credentials to this file.

# Cloud provider key formats
AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}
ASIA[0-9A-Z]{16}
A3T[A-Z0-9]|AKIA|AGPA|AIDA|AROA|AIPA|ANPA|ANVA|ASIA
aws_secret_access_key\s*[:=]\s*['"]?[A-Za-z0-9/+=]{40}
aws_session_token\s*[:=]\s*['"]?[A-Za-z0-9/+=]{100,}
AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}
[0-9]+-[0-9a-z_]{32}\.apps\.googleusercontent\.com
"type"\s*:\s*"service_account"
"private_key_id"\s*:\s*"[0-9a-f]{40}"
ya29\.[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20,}
AccountKey=[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{86,88}
DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=[^;]+;AccountKey=
SharedAccessSignature=sv=[0-9-]+&
sig=[A-Za-z0-9%]{43,53}%3D
[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.vault\.azure\.net
dop_v1_[a-f0-9]{64}
doo_v1_[a-f0-9]{64}
LTAI[0-9A-Za-z]{12,20}

# Source control and CI tokens
gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}
github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{80,}
glpat-[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20}
gldt-[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20}
glptt-[0-9a-f]{40}
ATBB[A-Za-z0-9_=.-]{30,}
CIRCLE_TOKEN\s*[:=]\s*['"]?[0-9a-f]{40}
TRAVIS_TOKEN\s*[:=]
travis encrypt
x-access-token:[^@\s]+@github\.com

npm_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}
//registry\.npmjs\.org/:_authToken=
_authToken\s*=
pypi-AgEIcHlwaS5vcmc[A-Za-z0-9_-]{50,}
rubygems_[0-9a-f]{48}
oy2[a-z0-9]{43}
dckr_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{27}

# Messaging, payment and SaaS keys
xox[baprs]-[0-9A-Za-z-]{10,}
xapp-[0-9]-[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+
https://hooks\.slack\.com/services/T[A-Z0-9]{8,}/B[A-Z0-9]{8,}/[A-Za-z0-9]{24}
https://discord(app)?\.com/api/webhooks/[0-9]{17,20}/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{60,}
[MN][A-Za-z\d]{23,25}\.[\w-]{6}\.[\w-]{27,38}
[0-9]{8,10}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35}
sk_live_[0-9a-zA-Z]{24,}
rk_live_[0-9a-zA-Z]{24,}
pk_live_[0-9a-zA-Z]{24,}
whsec_[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}
sq0atp-[0-9A-Za-z_-]{22}
sq0csp-[0-9A-Za-z_-]{43}
EAA[0-9A-Za-z]{100,}
shpat_[a-fA-F0-9]{32}
shpss_[a-fA-F0-9]{32}
shpca_[a-fA-F0-9]{32}
SG\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}

[0-9a-f]{32}-us[0-9]{1,2}

# Private keys and certificates
-----BEGIN (RSA|EC|DSA|OPENSSH|PGP|ENCRYPTED)? ?PRIVATE KEY( BLOCK)?-----
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
-----BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK-----
PuTTY-User-Key-File-[0-9]:
ssh-(rsa|ed25519|dss) AAAA[0-9A-Za-z+/]+
\.pem|\.p12|\.pfx|\.jks|\.keystore|\.ppk|id_rsa|id_ed25519

# Tokens and credentials in URLs and headers
eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}
[Bb]earer\s+[A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]{20,}=*
[Bb]asic\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16,}={0,2}
Authorization:\s*(Bearer|Basic|Token)\s+\S+
[?&](api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|token|secret|password|passwd|pwd|key)=[^&\s]{6,}
https?://[^/\s:@]+:[^/\s:@]+@[^/\s]+
X-Api-Key:\s*\S+
X-Auth-Token:\s*\S+

# Connection strings and database credentials
(postgres(ql)?|mysql|mariadb|mongodb(\+srv)?|redis|rediss|amqps?|mssql|sqlserver)://[^:\s/]+:[^@\s/]+@
jdbc:[a-z]+://[^\s'"]+(password|pwd)=[^&\s'"]+
Server=[^;]+;Database=[^;]+;(User Id|Uid)=[^;]+;(Password|Pwd)=[^;]+
mongodb(\+srv)?://[^\s'"]+
[a-z0-9-]+\.firebaseio\.com
[a-z0-9-]+\.firebaseapp\.com
https://[a-z0-9-]+\.supabase\.co
sbp_[0-9a-f]{40}
eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9
DB_PASSWORD\s*[:=]
DATABASE_URL\s*[:=]

# Generic assignment patterns (high noise: review each hit)
(?i)(api[_-]?key|apikey|secret|client[_-]?secret|access[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|private[_-]?key|passwd|password|pwd)['"]?\s*[:=]\s*['"][^'"\s]{8,}['"]
(?i)(aws|azure|gcp|google|github|slack|stripe|twilio|sendgrid|mailgun|heroku|firebase)[a-z0-9_ -]{0,20}(key|secret|token)['"]?\s*[:=]
(?i)(secret|token|password)['"]?\s*:\s*['"][A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{16,}['"]
(?i)bearer\s+[a-z0-9._-]{20,}

# Search commands: repositories and history (own or in-scope repositories)
gitleaks detect --source . --redact --verbose
gitleaks detect --source . --log-opts="--all" --redact
trufflehog git file://. --only-verified --no-update
trufflehog filesystem . --no-update
trufflehog github --org=EXAMPLE_ORG --only-verified
git log -p --all -G 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'
git log -p --all -S 'BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY'
git log --all --diff-filter=D --name-only -- '*.env' '*.pem' '*.key'
git rev-list --all | xargs git grep -I -n -E 'api[_-]?key|secret' 
git grep -I -n -E '(password|secret|token)\s*[:=]'
git reflog expire --expire=now --all
git fsck --lost-found
rg -n --hidden -g '!node_modules' -e 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'
rg -n --hidden -g '!.git' -e '-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----'
grep -rIn --exclude-dir=.git -E 'api[_-]?key|secret|token|passw' .
detect-secrets scan
semgrep --config p/secrets .

# Search commands: JavaScript, source maps and web content (in scope only)
curl -s https://app.example.test/ | grep -oE 'src="[^"]+\.js"'
curl -s https://app.example.test/static/js/main.js | grep -oE '(api[_-]?key|secret|token)[^,;]{0,60}'
curl -s https://app.example.test/static/js/main.js | grep -oE 'https?://[A-Za-z0-9./_-]+'
curl -s https://app.example.test/static/js/main.js.map
curl -s https://app.example.test/static/js/main.js | tail -c 200
//# sourceMappingURL=
//# sourceURL=
unwebpack-sourcemap --make-directory main.js.map ./out
sourcemapper -url https://app.example.test/static/js/main.js.map -output ./out
katana -u https://app.example.test -jc -d 3 -silent
gau app.example.test | grep -E '\.js(\?|$)'
waybackurls app.example.test | grep -E '\.(js|json|map|env|bak|config)(\?|$)'
linkfinder -i https://app.example.test/static/js/main.js -o cli
nuclei -u https://app.example.test -t http/exposures/
nuclei -u https://app.example.test -t http/exposures/tokens/
httpx -l hosts.txt -path /.env,/.git/config,/config.json -mc 200 -silent

# Search commands: mobile apps, containers and artifacts (own or in-scope builds)
apktool d app.apk -o app-src
jadx -d app-jadx app.apk
strings -n 8 app.apk | grep -E 'AIza|AKIA|sk_live|xox[baprs]'
grep -rIn -E 'AIza|AKIA|sk_live|xox[baprs]' app-src app-jadx
unzip -p app.ipa 'Payload/*/*.plist' | strings | grep -iE 'key|secret|token'
docker history --no-trunc IMAGE
docker save IMAGE | tar -xO | grep -aE 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'
trivy image --scanners secret IMAGE
dive IMAGE

# Locations to review (not patterns)
# Environment files: .env, .env.local, .env.production
# Build output: asset-manifest.json, webpack stats, *.map, __NEXT_DATA__, window.__INITIAL_STATE__
# Config files: config.json, appsettings.json, application.yml, settings.py, wp-config.php
# CI files: .github/workflows, .gitlab-ci.yml, Jenkinsfile, buildspec.yml
# API collections: Postman collections and environments, Insomnia exports, OpenAPI files with examples
# Logs and debug pages: /actuator/env, /debug, /phpinfo.php, stack traces
# Public paste, issue tracker and chat exports referencing the organisation
# HTML comments and inline scripts

# What to record for a finding (without pasting the full secret)
# The URL or file and line where the pattern was found
# The secret type and a redacted prefix (for example the first four characters)
# The date the file was published or last changed, and whether it is in history
# The permission scope if it can be shown without using the credential
# The recommended action: revoke, rotate, remove from history, and add scanning to CI
